notes.title: Lunar New Year sale!
notes.notes: Not done celebrating the New Year yet! Strings Theory is a part of the #LunarNewYear #SteamSale, and we're there for the event too, streaming the game on @Steam 🎮 You can try the game out yourselves too, with the demo available now, or get it with 30% off 🏷️

notes.title: HeyBox Game Festival showcase + Demo
notes.notes:
Strings Theory's adventures in China continue! After #JumpHigh Event this time, we're pleased to showcase our colorful heroes during HeyBox Game Festival on #Steam. Check out all of the festival games here:

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/heyboxgamefestival

We have also made Strings Theory demo available again for the time of the Festival! A perfect opportunity to try it out before deciding on a purchase.

Happy playing!

notes.title: The day has come! OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
The day has come ⁠— the day when four unique misfits-turned-heroes set off on a fantastic journey! Strings Theory releases today, on December 14th, and it does feel like a dream come true, to say at least, but to them... to them, the only thing they may feel now is the threat of doom. So jump right in and give them a helping hand. They need that a lot!

Make sure to share your thoughts in a review; your feedback is what drives us to deliver the best adventure!
